items.title: Explore Tracks
items.body: Discover and fine tracks to insert in your experiences, curated by me.

items.title: Write a suggestion
items.body: Suggest a feature or new sounds to be added to the pack.

items.title: Welcome to SoundPack
items.body: Browse the library, tap ♡ to save tracks, and use Insert or Code usage to put a sound into your experience. Tap + on the home screen to keep your own tracks across every experience.

items.title: Get live updates
items.body: Turn on Allow HTTP Requests (Game Settings → Security) to receive new tracks and notifications and to send suggestions. SoundPack works fine without it, using the built-in library.

items.title: Affiliate & Support
items.body: Insert a merch booth or sell UGC Avatar Items to earn a comission on each purchase. donate by purchasing a gamepass and receive a badge.
